additions.site_name: Delska Riga data centre campus, Čuibes iela 17
additions.name: Delska EU North Riga LV DC1, existing operations

status.summary: On September 28 Delska identified Riga DC1 as its recently opened facility.

locator.method: Geographic coordinates in the Latvian State Address Register for active address 104743498.
locator.precision: Representative civic address point for the Delska campus shared by Riga DC1 and DC2.
locator.identity_review: Delska lists both facilities at Cuibes street 17, Riga, LV-1063. Record 104743498 gives the matching Latvian address, Čuibes iela 17, Rīga, LV-1063. The address locates the shared property.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The address record supplies no horizontal survey accuracy for this point.

additions.distinctness_review: Delska lists DC1 and DC2 as distinct facilities at Čuibes iela 17. This project covers DC1. Snapshot 205’s announced DC4 is on a separate property at Latgales iela 463.
additions.successor_review: Delska reported the April opening, identified DC1 as open on September 28, and continues to offer customer deployments on its facility page.

additions.name: Google Council Bluffs Southlands campus — existing operations

status.summary: On September 14, Council Bluffs community development staff identified Google Southlands as the city’s largest hyperscale data center and distinguished it from Google’s Veterans Memorial Highway facility.

locator.method: National Address Database property address point, checked against the county parcel and city planning record.
locator.precision: Property-level point for the established Southlands campus. Positional placement within the property is unspecified. Individual buildings and campus boundaries are not mapped.
locator.identity_review: The county parcel intersecting this address point is recorded to Questa LLC as Southlands Subdivision lot 1. The city’s planning report assigns the data center to lot 1, and its development agreement names Google Southland.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The original address point has unknown placement and no stated numerical positional uncertainty.

additions.distinctness_review: The September city presentation identifies Google Southlands separately from Google’s Veterans Memorial Highway location and the Edged development. Only Edged is in snapshot 205 for Council Bluffs.
additions.successor_review: The city describes the established Southlands campus in September 2026. Google separately reports operating performance for its second Council Bluffs facility. No later expansion phase or completion claim is assigned to this project.

additions.name: Google Eemshaven data centre campus, existing operations

status.summary: On September 25 Google Cloud reported that its Eemshaven data centre hosted workloads migrated by Deutsche Telekom.

locator.method: Native coordinates of the active BAG civic address for Oostpolder 4, Eemshaven.
locator.precision: Official civic address point for the operating campus at Oostpolder 4. The point represents the property shared by its buildings.
locator.identity_review: Groningen Province lists Google / Green Box Computing BV at Oostpolder 4 in Eemshaven. The official BAG entry identifies the same street, number and locality.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The BAG feature supplies no metre-level accuracy value for this individual point.

additions.distinctness_review: The established Google campus at Oostpolder 4 is separate from the QTS-branded Eemshaven project already in snapshot 205. The provincial record identifies Google / Green Box Computing. Google lists other Dutch campuses separately.
additions.successor_review: Google Cloud’s September 25 first-party case identifies the operating Eemshaven facility. The operator dates its initial opening to December 2016. The present project covers the established campus.

additions.name: DCI H1 Cibitung, JK6 Phase 4 construction
additions.site_identity_review: DCI’s launch announcement places JK6 on the H1 Cibitung campus. The filing names JK6 Phase 4. The campus point represents part of block GG-5-1 in the MM2100 estate.

status.summary: DCI reported JK6 Phase 4 was under construction and estimated 65.24% complete on September 30, 2026. The company expected completion in 2027.

locator.identity_review: DCI’s launch announcement places JK6 on the H1 Cibitung campus. The filing names JK6 Phase 4. The campus point represents part of block GG-5-1 in the MM2100 estate.

additions.distinctness_review: H1’s existing commercial operations include JK6, which DCI opened on June 3, 2025. The quarterly filing separately identifies the subsequent fourth phase of that building.
additions.successor_review: The September 30 schedule reports Phase 4 as under construction and estimates completion in 2027. The 2025 comparator refers to the prior third phase. The 2027 estimate has year precision.

additions.name: SM+ Jakarta SMX01

status.summary: SM+ confirmed on November 1 that SMX01 had begun operations and was ready to serve customers in Jakarta.

locator.method: Centre of the bounding box of the named OpenStreetMap commercial site polygon.
locator.precision: Approximate reference point for the Yellowstone property in Menteng Atas.
locator.identity_review: DataGarda uses SMX01 and Yellowstone together for its South Jakarta project. The issuer’s project permits identify the Kuningan Mulia and Taman Rasuna Utara frontage, where OpenStreetMap places the named site.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The map provides no surveyed positional accuracy for the commercial property.

additions.distinctness_review: Digital Edge EDGE2 is a separate facility on Kuningan Mulia, owned by a different company at a separate mapped property. SMX01 is the Yellowstone project on the Taman Rasuna Utara frontage.
additions.successor_review: The November launch concerns the existing SMX01 facility. The release describes possible later modular expansion without announcing another operational phase.

status.summary: Firebird reports the Hrazdan first phase is complete and serving workloads.

status_updates.identity_review: The operator names its existing Hrazdan AI cluster and distinguishes a subsequent expansion.
status_updates.successor_review: The November 21 statement confirms the existing first phase’s operation after the August 8 baseline observation.

operating_model_updates.identity_review: Delska offers unit, full rack and space rental in the facility-specific DC1 description.
Firebird identifies its specialist AI cloud business and links the training service to its Armenian AI factory. Its November release identifies Hrazdan as the operating first phase.
The operator’s Tirana facility page offers customers space for their own servers from a single rack unit up to a full 42U rack.
Neotel describes its Skopje NeoDC facility as an operator-neutral colocation data centre.
Google identifies its own Council Bluffs data centers and distinguishes the facility added in 2012. Its signed project letter identifies that property as Southlands.
Google identifies Eemshaven as its own operating campus. Its facility directory and dated customer case document Google-operated cloud services there.
DCI’s facility directory offers customer colocation at its H1 campus in Cibitung. The entry identifies five live buildings and lists JK6 as a campus member.
The November 1 release explicitly identifies SMX01 as a colocation data center.
The CGK10 sheet names the Daan Mogot Rd, Kalideres property and describes colocation from single cabinets to full suites.
The CGK11 sheet names the MT Haryono St, Jatinegara property and describes colocation from single racks to multi-megawatt deployments.
Equinix explicitly classifies Singapore SG6 phase 1 in its retail IBX expansion schedule. Its November 6 statement reports the first phase opened.
